Thanksgiving Dinner Is Moving to Restaurants
videos.description: Bloomberg Pursuits Food Editor Kate Krader tells Bloomberg This Weekend that more Americans are choosing restaurants for Thanksgiving as higher grocery costs, cooking stress and cleanup make dining out increasingly attractive. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Krader explains how restaurants are responding with traditional feasts and unconventional menus as Thanksgiving reservations continue to rise. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: Is AI a Bubble? History Offers Some Clues
videos.description: Bloomberg Opinion columnist Justin Fox tells Bloomberg This Weekend that history offers warning signs for financial bubbles, but little reliable guidance about exactly when they will burst, making debt and investor sentiment important risks to watch amid the AI boom. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Fox explains why AI can be a transformative technology while its companies and investments are still vulnerable to inflated expectations and a painful market correction. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: GTA 6: The Blockbuster That is Changing Gaming Forever
videos.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is one of the biggest entertainment releases in recent history. But can one blockbuster video game revive an industry facing layoffs, consolidation and slowing consumer spending? NYU Stern professor Joost van Dreunen and Griffin Gaming Partners’ Nick Tuosto examine what GTA 6 means for developers, distributors, industry consolidation and investment opportunities for this hundred billion-dollar industry. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
